title: Beamfall Relay Carrier Handshake Frame (v1)
description: Wire schema for the relay carrier handshake protocol (ADR-0018, ADR-0122). Length-prefixed JSON: 4-byte big-endian uint32 length followed by this JSON object. Max frame size 65536 bytes. Both the relay server (AGPL) and core carrier client (proprietary) must conform to this schema.

type.description: Frame discriminator. Exactly one of: 'hello' (client→server registration), 'ack' (server→client acceptance), 'error' (either direction, connection terminates after).

error.description: Non-empty when type='error'. Absent (omitempty) otherwise. Human-readable reason string; known values: 'invalid hello', 'unauthorized'.

version.description: Protocol version. Both sides must agree; mismatch causes an error frame.

token.description: Opaque carrier authentication token. Encoded as base64 string in JSON (Go []byte marshals as base64). Must not be logged.

hostnames.description: Hostnames this carrier serves. Each must be a valid DNS label sequence.

version.description: Informational protocol version echoed from the accepted hello. Carriers do not enforce this value after the hello is accepted.

carrier_id.description: Server-assigned carrier identifier for this registration.

hostnames.description: Hostnames the relay registered for this carrier (may differ from requested list).
